messages:
cara: Hey team, PR #4821 needs a docs review before we can merge the migration guide change. CI passed but docs preview is timing out in eu-west region :grimacing:

mike: I can take it but I'm in CET. What merge window are we aiming for?

sasha: FYI I started a preview job, it's stuck on the assets build step. logs: https://ci.example.com/4821/preview -> shows `Fetching assets` for 20m :hourglass_flowing_sand:

cara: Thanks @sasha. We were hoping to merge during the US afternoon window (3pm-5pm PT) to let platform smoke tests run overnight. That would be ~midnight for you @mike, sorry.

mike: Oof, that's rough. I'm happy to review earlier if someone can unblock the preview. Otherwise I can do a quick high-level pass and approve, then follow up tomorrow for nit fixes.

jordan: I'm on US-PST and can do the merge during the window if we get an approval. Could also pick up the preview rerun around 2:30pm PT.

cara: Option: @mike does content review + approve, @jordan handles the merge during the window. That avoids you staying up late. Anyone object? :thinking_face:

sasha: Works for me. Also filing a small follow-up issue to split the giant example notebook into two - that's what's inflating asset build time.

mike: Ok I'll review now. Quick heads-up: there's an SDK snippet in the migration guide that uses the old `client.create_embed` API; should be `client.embeddings.create` now. I'll paste the snippet I want changed below:
```python
# current
resp = client.create_embed(texts=["hello"])
# suggested
resp = client.embeddings.create(input=["hello"])
```

cara: Great catch. @docs-bot can you post a quick note to the PR to update that snippet and run a preview after the change?

docs-bot: Hi! I've left a comment on PR #4821 requesting the SDK snippet update and queued a preview rebuild. Preview job id: preview-4821-2.

sasha: preview-4821-2 started in us-west, but I see the eu-west runner still has the stale cache that caused slow builds earlier. Kicking the cache refresh now.

mike: Review comments are in. I left one content nit and one code example change (above). Approving once those are fixed. :thumbsup:

cara: Thanks! @jordan can you wait for the green preview and I will assign the merge to you for the 3pm PT window?

jordan: Yep will be ready. Also, quick suggestion for future: add a small `preview-checklist.md` to docs/ci with platform region hints and expected asset size to help others avoid region timeouts.

sasha: +1 to the checklist. I'll open a tiny PR after this merges.

cara: Perfect. Final plan: @mike updates snippet and approves, @sasha ensures preview builds across regions, @jordan merges in 3pm-4pm PT window. I'll post a short comment on the PR outlining the handoff. Thanks all :rocket:
